title: YAMPI (Dynamics 365 Business Central Admin MCP Server) version 2.0.x: a ground-up refresh.
summary: YAMPI is an open-source MCP Server that enables AI assistants like GitHub Copilot and Claude to perform advanced Business Central administration tasks through natural language. Version 2.0 is a comprehensive refresh that expands tools from 34 to 52, upgrades to .NET 10, adds environment lifecycle management, PTE deployment via Admin Center API, enhanced security confirmations, and cross-platform support with improved reliability and testing.
key_points: 18 new tools added including environment lifecycle management (rename, restore, recover), database export, security group access control, and M365 license control
PTE deployment moved from deprecated Automation API to Admin Center API v2.29 with batch folder deployment and dependency ordering
Production environment changes now require confirmation prompts and destructive tools are marked for safer operation
Sign-in credentials cached in OS token storage (DPAPI/Keychain/keyring) across sessions rather than memory only
Platform support expanded to Windows, Linux, and macOS on both x64 and ARM64 architectures with 103 automated tests and CI pipeline

quotes.text: The sign-in is now stored in the operating system's encrypted token cache (Windows DPAPI, macOS Keychain, Linux keyring), so it survives restarts.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates improved usability and security compared to in-memory session-only credentials

quotes.text: Packages are published with npm trusted publishing (OIDC): no npm token is stored anywhere, and every package carries a provenance attestation.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights security best practices for open-source distribution and artifact verification
